stateNote: Begin garnishing the crêpe with solid fillings, if using. If you want to use something very liquid as a topping such as marmalade, juice, or alcohol, don't do this on the plate as the crêpe gets soggy, and the plate may get sticky. If you want to fold the crêpe when it's done, you should only garnish one half of the crêpe—otherwise the filling may fall down in the fold, liquid may flow out, and the crepe may become messy.
